menu.subtitle: The Job Hunt
menu.footer: WASD / Arrows to move. Space/Enter or click to confirm.

level1Intro.subject: Subject: Congratulations on completing your Computer Science degree
level1Intro.greeting: Congratulations on completing your Computer Science degree.
level1Intro.body1: The first step toward a job is the career fair. Find the recruiter who is willing to accept you and hand her your CV.
level1Intro.body2: Heads up: the guards are checking who belongs at the event. Do not let them identify you as an outsider.
level1Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level2Intro.subject: Subject: Your first technical interview
level2Intro.greeting: Congratulations on moving forward. Welcome to your first technical interview.
level2Intro.body1: Your task is to build our Binary Search Tree as completely as possible.
level2Intro.body2: For every leaf, values placed to the left must be smaller, and values placed to the right must be larger. Your score is based on how many leaves you place correctly.
level2Intro.body3: Finish before time runs out, and watch out for incoming bugs.
level2Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level3Intro.subject: Subject: Linked list database incident
level3Intro.body: Oh no! Our linked list has spiraled out of control and is destroying the database! Your mission is to reverse the linked list. You must jump on each node one by one to reverse its direction, starting from the Head all the way to the Tail. But be careful—it won't go down without a fight!
level3Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level4Intro.subject: Subject: Technical assessment update
level4Intro.body: Congratulations on passing the technical assessments! While your performance was impressive, we currently have many strong candidates under consideration. We need to evaluate each profile and we will be in touch with you shortly. Thank you for your interest.
level4Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level1.allRecruitersGone: All recruiters are done for today. Bring CV faster.
level1.noOpenTarget: No open target at the moment.
level1.acceptedNoExperience: Thank you for applying, but you still don't have enough experience.
level1.trashWarning: Oh no, they threw away your CV. Please pick it back up.
level1.guardCaught: Hey, you don't belong here. Get out.

level2.title: BST Orchard
level2.initialFeedback: Place leaves by BST rules, then submit.
level2.standNearSubmit: Stand next to the red submit button.
level2.leafLifted: Leaf lifted. Move it to a new branch.
level2.moveCloserSlot: Move closer to a leaf slot.
level2.leafPlaced: Leaf placed. Submit checks the full BST.
level2.branchOccupied: This branch already has a leaf.
level2.branchInactive: This branch is not part of the task.
level2.placeOne: Place at least one leaf before submitting.
level2.invalidTree: Tree is not a valid BST yet.

level3.title: Reverse Linked List Snake
level3.subtitle: Jump on the glowing node, press E, dodge fire and falling spikes.

level5.intro: You were the best in interviews, but the role is no longer needed because of AI.
level5.congratsShutdown: Congrats on the new job! But the company shut down.
